knowledge.text: 電容電壓大幅改變時，DC/DC 能維持負載匯流排但增加電流。

knowledge.titleEn: Configure a bidirectional DC interface: evidence
knowledge.text: 固定 1 kW，比較 48 V 與 24 V 的理想輸入電流 20.8 與 41.7 A。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed 1 kW compare ideal input currents of 20.8 A at 48 V and 41.7 A at 24 V.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：100 F 模組從 48 V 放至 36 V，可用 E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh；不是用 48 V×100 F 得能量。若 ESR=20 mΩ、電流 100 A，瞬時壓降 2 V、熱損 200 W。 等效 RC 只描述選定時間尺度；漏電、溫度及老化必須另量測，教學假設不是充電安全限值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 F module discharged from 48 to 36 V provides E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh. Voltage times farads is not energy. With ESR=20 mΩ at 100 A, the immediate drop is 2 V and heating is 200 W. An equivalent RC model describes only selected timescales; leakage, temperature and aging need separate measurement, and examples are not safe charging limits.

steps.title: 配置雙向 DC 介面：反證與驗收

steps.failure: 若「配置雙向 DC 介面」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把電容量、ESR、串聯均壓與脈衝功率分配的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If configure a bidirectional dc interface disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of capacitance, ESR, series balancing and pulse-power allocation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「配置雙向 DC 介面」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for configure a bidirectional dc interface, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
